en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own trip and get the same Cape Town plan with the fees double-checked
en.runTitle: A Frankfurt couple, five days in Cape Town in February 2027, about EUR 1,600 without flights

fields.label: Travellers, passports and mobility needs
fields.value: A couple from Frankfurt with German passports; nervous about safety

fields.label: Dates and flight times
fields.value: Arrive Saturday morning 13 February 2027, leave Thursday evening 18 February 2027

fields.label: Budget and exclusions
fields.value: About EUR 1,600 for two, excluding flights

en.template: Plan Cape Town for {travellers} on {dates}, with {budget}. Compare one-base rides and shared tours against a fully costed hire car. Keep backup mountain weather windows, verify the Cape Point fee discrepancy and Boulders tariff, and distinguish dated samples from real room and tour quotes. Check entry, customs, insurance and return transport. Plan only; do not book, contact anyone, submit forms, create accounts or pay.

phases.title: Check current entry rules, safety advice, attraction prices, power cuts and places to stay
phases.note: Entry and customs, safety advice, Table Mountain, the Cape Peninsula and Green Point guest houses
phases.judgment: One colleague took back its own claim: it had reported opening the park service’s official fee table, but both attempts to open it had actually been blocked, so the Cape Point and Boulders fees it quoted were pulled back as unverified.

phases.title: Build the day-by-day plan and a budget in euros and rand that adds up
phases.note: Five days around a Green Point base, with a weather buffer day
phases.judgment: Where two sources disagreed on the Cape Point fee (R592 against R595), the budget uses the higher figure and says the official table could not be opened. Hotel prices are shown as dated samples, not quotes, because the published rates did not cover February.

phases.title: Write and check the itinerary page and the source list

workers: Checked entry rules for German passport holders, official safety advice for Cape Town and the current electricity situation
Looked up Green Point guest house prices, Table Mountain and park fees and a shared Peninsula tour, and corrected its own report when a source could not be opened

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的行程，得到同样把收费核对过的开普敦规划
zh.runTitle: 法兰克福的一对情侣，2027 年 2 月在开普敦玩五天，不含机票约 1600 欧元

fields.label: 人数、护照和行动需求
fields.value: 来自法兰克福的一对情侣，持德国护照；对安全有些担心

fields.label: 日期及航班时间
fields.value: 2027 年 2 月 13 日（周六）上午到达，2 月 18 日（周四）晚上离开

fields.label: 预算和不包含项目
fields.value: 两个人约 1600 欧元，不含机票

zh.template: 请按{travellers}、{dates}、{budget}规划开普敦。比较固定住处加叫车及共享团，与算全成本的租车方案。给桌山留天气备选，核实 Cape Point 收费差异和 Boulders 门票，分清带日期示例与实际住房及团费报价。检查入境、海关、保险和回程交通。只做规划，不预订、不联系、不提交表格、不开户、不付款。

phases.title: 核对最新的入境规定、安全提醒、景点价格、停电情况和住处
phases.note: 入境和海关、安全提醒、桌山、开普半岛和 Green Point 的民宿
phases.judgment: 一位同事收回了自己的说法：它之前说打开了国家公园管理局的官方收费表，实际两次尝试都被拦住了，所以它引用的 Cape Point 和 Boulders 收费被撤回，改为未核实。

phases.title: 做逐日安排，以及欧元和兰特都算得平的预算
phases.note: 以 Green Point 为基地的五天，留了一天看天气的机动日
phases.judgment: Cape Point 的收费两处来源说法不一（592 兰特对 595 兰特），预算取较高的数字，并说明官方收费表没能打开。酒店价格只当带日期的示例，不是报价，因为公布的价格没有覆盖 2 月。

phases.title: 写好并检查行程网页和来源清单

workers: 查德国护照的入境规定、开普敦的官方安全提醒和当前的电力情况
查 Green Point 民宿价格、桌山和公园收费，以及一个共享的半岛团；有来源打不开时，主动更正了自己的报告
